correctness.rationale: Every visited set is a cycle interval. Dihedral symmetry decouples expected remaining cover time at each new-vertex discovery. Optimal interval-exit values satisfy the 3/4-minimum and 1/4-maximum Bellman equation. The two explicit, nonnegative geometric profiles obey all interior, boundary and central equations and enforce the selected nearest-boundary policy. Uniform geometric absorption controls arbitrary policies; summing exact h_k(0) yields both parity expressions. Standalone exact rational checker passed 21,972 assertions, but the infinite theorem follows from the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The exact global controller and finite-size mean solve the natural canonical one-dimensional instance of the published two-choice cover-time problem, sharpening its known Theta(n) result to 2n-9/2 with exponentially small parity correction. It provides a nontrivial structural Bellman profile and quantified sharp speedup relative to the quadratic cover time of the ordinary cycle walk.
